create_layer_widget: create a LayerWidget instance by passing a viz object to the constructor
render_layer_widget_ui: call the LayerWidget with show=True to render the ImGui layer visualization UI
select_network_layer: use the LayerWidget checkbox list to select which neural network layer to visualize
adjust_image_display_options: use the LayerWidget sliders to adjust image scale, channel selection, and normalization settings
configure_fft_analysis: enable FFT visualization and adjust range and Kaiser beta parameters via LayerWidget controls
